from math import gcd


def best_average(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    T = 40
    P = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i, v in enumerate(a):
        P[i + 1] = P[i] + v
    PS = [p << T for p in P]

    mx = max(a)
    lo = 0
    hi = (mx << T) + 1
    NEG = -(1 << 300)

    def scan(X):
        # max over subarrays (i, j] with j - i >= k of
        # (P[j] - P[i]) * 2^T - X * (j - i); also track argmax
        minB = PS[0]
        argi = 0
        xm = 0
        xj = X * k
        bestv = NEG
        bi = bj = 0
        for j in range(k, n + 1):
            m = j - k
            bm = PS[m] - xm
            if bm < minB:
                minB = bm
                argi = m
            v = PS[j] - xj - minB
            if v > bestv:
                bestv = v
                bi = argi
                bj = j
            xm += X
            xj += X
        return bestv, bi, bj

    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi + 1) >> 1
        if scan(mid)[0] >= 0:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid - 1

    _, bi, bj = scan(lo)
    num = P[bj] - P[bi]
    den = bj - bi
    g = gcd(num, den)
    return [num // g, den // g]
